## Context
A serial full-suite run failed after 13,914 passing tests at `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_cutover.py::test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas`. The test monkeypatches `rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf._marklas` to return `None`, but the codec rendered rich ADF while the direct function returned plain ADF. The test passes in isolation.

## Phase 1 plan
- Reproduce a minimal predecessor/test ordering and capture the divergent runtime module identities.
- Compare isolated behavior, inspect the codec/function call graph, test fixtures, module cache state, and recent history.
- Obtain independent falsifiable hypotheses and run discriminating runtime experiments until one changeable mechanism explains isolated-green and ordered-red behavior.
- Establish defect legitimacy and complete the bounded caller-dependency gate before repair.
- Write the proven RCA and evidence back before Phase 2.

## Phase 2 plan
- Freeze a minimal runtime identity oracle and observe it RED before repair.
- Keep the oracle held out from the fixer.
- Validate GREEN, exact-defect mutation RED, focused/broader gates, original ordering replication, and sibling/parity sweeps.

## Testing
- `pytest -q tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py::test_by_path_loader_preserves_module_identity_for_the_same_source` proves same-name/same-source identity and the different-source control.
- `pytest -q tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py::test_description_survives_outbound_adf_inbound_unchanged tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_cutover.py::test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas` replicates the reported integration-before-unit ordering.
- `make lint` and `make typecheck` are the repository gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A deterministic minimal reproduction is recorded with its exact `pytest` command.
- [ ] The isolated working case is compared with the ordered failing case using runtime identity evidence.
- [ ] Relevant git history is inspected and cited in the RCA.
- [ ] Prior related tickets are inspected and cited in the RCA.
- [ ] A proven root cause is recorded before repair.
- [ ] Defect legitimacy is recorded before repair.
- [ ] The caller-dependency conclusion is recorded before repair.
- [ ] The held-out runtime identity test is observed RED before repair and GREEN afterward.
- [ ] Deleting the cache-first guard returns the held-out test to RED.
- [ ] The focused rich-text and round-trip suites pass.
- [ ] The exact integration-before-unit ordering passes.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
- [ ] Construct and parity sibling sweeps receive explicit dispositions.
